newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands submits plan to Placer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands submits plan to Placer.

text.p: Papuan New Guinea gold miner Highlands Gold Ltd said on Monday it had submitted a restructuring proposal to hostile bidder Placer Dome Inc that would provide Highlands shareholders with substantially greater value than Placer's 75 cents per share bid.

Through a scheme of arrangement, Highlands said each of its shares not held by Placer would be cancelled in exchange for a capital return of 65 cents per share and one new share in a new company, Highlands Pacific Ltd.
The new company will hold all of Highlands Gold's non-Porgera assets while Placer will acquire Highlands Gold's 25 percent interest in Porgera.
Highland's non-gold assets include interests in the Ramu nickel/cobalt and Frieda/Nena copper/gold projects and as well as its exploration portfolio and database in Papua New Guinea and Indonesia.

Included in the proposal are a placement of Placer's shareholding entitlement in Highlands Pacific and an underwritten capital raising by Highlands Pacific to secure funding for the final feasibility study on Ramu, further work on
Frieda-Nena and the ongoing exploration programme.
Capital raising arrangements are expected to be completed by January 10 with the scheme expected to become effective in late February.
The scheme is subject to shareholder and regulatory authority approvals.
Highlands Gold's board said it continued to recommend shareholders reject Placer's bid.
